claims.text: Coral Bay Olefins commissioned the Sungai Liang ethane cracker in Brunei in 2025, marking the startup of the only ethane-based cracker in Southeast Asia since 2025.

citations.quote: Coral Bay Olefins has commissioned its Sungai Liang ethane cracker and associated HDPE line in Brunei.

claims.text: Coral Bay Olefins does not disclose the nameplate capacity of the Sungai Liang ethane cracker.

citations.quote: The company said it does not disclose nameplate capacity for the cracker.

claims.text: No expansions, debottlenecks, or major turnarounds have been reported for the Sungai Liang ethane cracker in Brunei since its commissioning in 2025.

citations.quote: Coral Bay said the complex reached stable operation within six weeks of first feed.

claims.text: No delays, FIDs, or project milestones have been reported for ethane-based crackers in Southeast Asia since 2025, other than the commissioning of Sungai Liang.

citations.quote: Coral Bay Olefins has commissioned its Sungai Liang ethane cracker and associated HDPE line in Brunei.

claims.text: Nusantara Olefins completed an expansion of Cilegon Cracker 1 in Indonesia in 2026, increasing ethylene capacity to 1,200 kta, but the evidence does not specify the feedstock and therefore cannot confirm if this is ethane-based.

citations.quote: Following the expansion, the company describes the unit as having an ethylene capacity of 1,200 kta.

gaps.subject: Sungai Liang cracker nameplate capacity
gaps.detail: Coral Bay Olefins does not disclose the nameplate capacity for the Sungai Liang ethane cracker.

citations.quote: The company said it does not disclose nameplate capacity for the cracker.

coverage_note: The evidence confirms only one ethane-based cracker in Southeast Asia (Sungai Liang, Brunei) with no publicly confirmed capacity or subsequent changes since commissioning in 2025. No other ethane-based projects, expansions, or milestones are reported for the region. The Cilegon expansion is noted but cannot be confirmed as ethane-based from available evidence.
